title: security: rbac v2 enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging for private deployments
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time for Private/VPC deployments and improve audit logging for KMS residency decisions. This change hardens data residency guarantees and provides operational visibility when requests are routed to KMS keys outside the requested region. Changeset overview: bump RBAC v2 policy schema to include `kms_residency` constraint; enforce region pinning in the policy engine at request admit time for private controller flows; emit structured audit events when a KMS residency check is performed (decision, actor, key_arn, requested_region, resolved_region, policy_id); add migration job to reconcile existing policies and surface invalid configs to tenant owners; add unit and integration tests; docs and console messaging. Checklist: - [x] Schema: add `kms_residency` constraint and migration logic; - [x] Enforce: policy engine honored in private controller path; - [x] Audit: structured event emitted to audit-log service and persisted; - [x] Tests: unit + integration + e2e private-installer smoke; - [x] Docs: RBAC policy docs + release notes; - [x] Rollout: feature-flagged enforcement with gradual enable for orgs. Backwards compatibility: enforcement is off by default for existing tenants; a Linear rollout plan (ENG-8742) will enable enforcement after migration. See linked Linear and SUP ticket for support cases. Migration notes: a migration job runs as part of the private-installer upgrade and marks policies with incompatible `kms_residency` values; operators will be alerted via console and can accept auto-fix or follow remediation steps in docs. Security review: SAST and threat modeling completed; no secret material is emitted in logs.
commits: policy: add kms_residency constraint to rbac v2 schema
engine: enforce kms region pinning in policy evaluator (private controller path)
audit: emit structured kms_residency audit events
installer: add migration job and reconciliation report
docs: update rbac v2 docs and migration guide
tests: add unit/integration/e2e coverage for residency checks
review_comments: Ravi Kapoor: Please clarify whether enforcement is gated by feature flag for all private clusters; also add rollback steps for the migration job.
Avery Chen: Enforcement is feature-flagged per-cluster; added rollback instructions to migration script and docs (see migration/README).
Elena Martinez: Audit events look noisy — can we sample or add rate-limiting? Also prefer structured JSON fields named `decision` and `reason`.
Avery Chen: Switched to structured JSON with `decision` and `reason`; added opt-in sampling for high-volume tenants and a config knob in audit-forwarder.
Samir Patel: Unit tests look good; request one e2e that simulates multi-region key fallback.
Avery Chen: Added e2e scenario and CI job; fixed a race in KV cache used by the evaluator.
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 for Private deployments (feature-flagged); structured audit events for KMS residency checks; migration job to reconcile policies; docs and console warnings added.
